name: WNPS Conservation Grants
summary: Small reimbursement grants for native plant materials in on-the-ground ecosystem restoration projects in Washington State; applicants must be WNPS members, acting alone or for chapters and other organisations.
reporting: A final report of at least 300-500 words with documentation and photos suitable for publication.

window.quote: WNPS provides small grants annually to further the mission around the state in 3 categories.
